council_map.vintage: Lake County Board of Elections & Registration map, "for reference only"; PDF made in ArcMap 10.8.1, created 2024-03-01, modified 2025-03-25. Shows 5 districts labelled by precinct (LS 01-LS 15). No adoption date or ordinance found; vintage after 2020 but not tied to a named ordinance.
council_map.notes: Saved as raw/lake-station-in/council-districts-3x5.pdf (image map, rendered and read: 1st=LS 01/02/03 east side, 2nd=LS 13/14NV and LS 06, 3rd=LS 05/07/04, 4th=LS 08/09, 5th=LS 11/12NV/15NV). Per-district 13x19 maps also exist at the same folder (district1 saved as raw/lake-station-in/district1-13x19.pdf). lakecounty.in.gov does not resolve from here; lakecountyin.gov serves the same files. Precinct labels were read by eye from the picture, not extracted as text. Search snippet quoted city code 3-2 saying 5 district + 2 at-large.

notes: City Judge Josh Matejczyk is listed on the elected-officials page (raw/lake-station-in/government.html) and the city has a City Court page (raw/lake-station-in/citycourt.html). Mayor/Clerk page and council page are undated.
